what_to_detect: The resolution of a cascade trigger casts an exiled nonland card of lower mana value without paying its mana cost.
near_miss: A cascade trigger's resolution that finds no such card and casts nothing.
record_fields: payload.events zone_change from_zone library to_zone exile
acting line keyword name (the acting line of a keyword-derived ability is the keyword's own line, whose script API type is Keyword, so api cannot single the keyword out)
